tools_problematic.problem: Initialize seeds MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md with a '| (none) | — |' table row when there are zero defer rows, but Validate expects the literal sentinel 'No items deferred' — so a fully clean migration is flagged.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt:3609 '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency'; trial MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contains '| (none) | — |' and never the string 'No items deferred'.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its no-defer PASS branch keys on the exact string 'No items deferred', which the scaffold it partners with never writes.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Make Initialize seed the exact sentinel 'No items deferred.' in the zero-defer case so the two scripts agree.

special_apis.special_handling: Accelerometer.GetDefault() returns null on machines with no sensor; the sample's own 'not found' status path is preserved and is correct — dead Enable/Disable buttons are hardware-gated, not a migration defect.

errors_encountered.error: CS8618: Non-nullable property 'Title' / 'ClassType' must contain a non-null value when exiting constructor (SampleConfiguration.cs, 4 warnings)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The shared UWP sample class `Scenario { public string Title { get; set; } public Type ClassType { get; set; } }` was migrated as-is into a project with `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>`; non-nullable auto-properties with no initializer trigger CS8618. This class ships in the shared SampleConfiguration.cs of 87 samples in this corpus.
errors_encountered.fix: Turn 33: initialize the auto-properties — `Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;` and `ClassType { get; set; } = typeof(object);` — yielding a 0-warning build.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: First build succeeded but emitted 4 CS8618 warnings; agent spent a build/fix/rebuild cycle to reach the '0 warnings' bar the skill sets for a clean build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Migrating the shared Scenario DTO verbatim under Nullable-enable; the skill documents the nullable pattern only for the App.MainWindow static, not for plain migrate-as-is data classes.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Initialized the two auto-properties with defaults; rebuild reported 0 warnings.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A one-line MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md note that migrate-as-is C# classes with non-nullable auto-properties emit CS8618 under <Nullable>enable</Nullable> and must be given field initializers (or the `required` modifier).

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Scaffold/validator sentinel mismatch: Initialize seeds '| (none) | — |', Validate's PASS branch requires the literal 'No items deferred'.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent correctly judged it benign and proceeded; no code change.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Aligning Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to seed the exact 'No items deferred.' sentinel in the zero-defer case.
